name: Inmate Deaths
description:
This dataset contains records of inmate deaths in correctional facilities, with each row representing a single reported incident. It has four columns: a unique incident ID, the date and time the incident was reported, the incident type, and the facility where it occurred. The sample covers 22 incidents reported between 2015 and later years, all classified as suicides, across seven facilities including AMKC, GRVC, OBCC, EMTC, and RMSC. Facility information is missing for roughly 23% of rows.

The data could support corrections oversight and transparency work, such as tracking suicide incidents over time, comparing counts across facilities, or examining reporting patterns. Because the extract is small and limited to a single incident type, it is best suited for illustrative or preliminary analysis rather than broad statistical conclusions.
